posts.title: The Ransomware Anniversary
posts.description: Five years ago today, Diamond Comic Distributors was struck by ransomware. Hackers associated with the Conti group infiltrated Diamond’s system and brought it down for almost a month. November 5th was a Friday. On Wednesday, we sent PREVIEWS #399 to press. posts.title: Two NPR Stories, Joined by Sorrow
posts.description: There were two stories on NPR over the weekend that, while not connected in themselves, have for me a personal connection. First, longtime NPR host Noah Adams died, aged eighty-four, just like my dad. Second, the American Girls dolls turn forty this year, and Samantha turns twenty-five.
